name: Document Intelligence

seo.title: Document Intelligence and AI Data Extraction | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that reads invoices, claims, statements and contracts, extracts structured data with confidence scores and routes exceptions to your team.

hero.headline: Turn documents into checked, structured data
hero.subheadline: We build extraction pipelines that read the documents your teams re-type today, show the source of every value, and send anything uncertain to a person instead of guessing.

intro: Most operations teams still copy data out of PDFs, scans and phone photos before the real work starts. Template OCR breaks on every new layout. We combine layout-aware OCR with large language models and your business rules, so the pipeline copes with new formats, cross-checks documents against each other, and keeps an audit trail of every value and every human correction.
what_we_build: Classification and splitting of mixed document bundles
Field and line-item extraction with confidence scores and source-page links
Reconciliation against ledgers, rate cards or policy rules
Integrations with ERP, core systems, CRMs and data warehouses
how_we_work: Agree the extraction schema with the people who use the data
Build on a sample of your real, de-identified documents
Measure field-level accuracy against what your team entered
Set confidence thresholds with you, then roll out

faqs.q: Do you need thousands of samples to start?
faqs.a: No. A pilot usually starts with a few hundred representative documents. Because the extraction uses language models with schemas, it does not need a template per layout.

faqs.q: What happens when the AI is unsure?
faqs.a: Every field carries a confidence score. Below the threshold you set, the field goes to a reviewer with the source page highlighted. Nothing uncertain is pushed downstream silently.

faqs.q: Can it handle Hindi or regional-language documents?
faqs.a: Yes for most printed documents, and partly for handwriting. The pilot reports accuracy by language and document type so you know where review is still needed.
